independent_review.scope: exactly one retained no-solver probe only

mandatory_execution_conditions: Replay every current artifact, source, runtime RECORD, Python, Bash, freeze-manifest, and invocation pin immediately before execution.
Recompute both canonical probe argv digests and require exact equality.
Use a read-only-root bwrap namespace with a fresh private writable /tmp and only the frozen v14 probe artifacts staged at their exact paths.
Obtain two MemAvailable samples of at least 1900000 KiB at least five seconds apart and confirm no competing heavy WSL process.
Execute exactly once, serialized against every other WSL-heavy task, with no automatic retry.

Reject unless the outer status is PASS, breach is absent, child exit is zero, cleanup is error-free with two stable zero snapshots, and every official-input, solver, checkpoint, and publication flag is false.
Retain command, environment, stdout, stderr, exit status, hashes, accounting peak, and post-exit cleanup evidence.
